				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-1c77567 elementor-widget-mobile__width-initial elementor-hidden-mobile elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="1c77567" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
					<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-default">KITESURFING<br></h2>				</div>
					<p class="e-d4679a0-d2c697b e-paragraph-base e-default-p" data-interaction-id="d4679a0">The next rider</p>
					<p class="e-458595f-348e26b e-paragraph-base e-default-p" data-interaction-id="458595f"><em>is you</em></p>
					<p class="e-6a3599e-7dad08e e-paragraph-base e-default-p" data-interaction-id="6a3599e">Every session is built around the wind conditions and your level, guaranteeing real progression in a safe environment. We provide all the equipment you need : kites, boards and harnesses, so you can focus entirely on your riding.<br><br>Our kite school can also come to you. We pick you up directly from your accommodation or meet at a convenient spot. Sessions are structured, safe, and paced to your rhythm, so you progress step by step, with confidence.</p>

<script>
(function(){
var ACT_CONTENT={
  surf:{
    badge:"🏄 SURF INCLUDED",
    items:[
      "Group surf lessons at the region's best spots (Sidi Kaouki, Essaouira bay...)",
      "Groups formed according to participants' level",
      "Transfers to the spots",
      "Board and wetsuit included",
      "Trips to the medina",
      "BBQ night at the villa for stays of 6+ nights",
      "Visit to an argan oil cooperative"
    ]
  },
  kite:{
    badge:"🪁 KITESURF INCLUDED",
    items:[
      "12 group kitesurf lessons, maximum 4 people per instructor",
      "Groups arranged according to each participant's level",
      "All necessary equipment provided (suitable kites, harnesses, helmets, vests, boards, wetsuits)",
      "Transfers to the spots",
      "Trips to the medina",
      "BBQ night at the villa for stays of 6+ nights",
      "Visit to an argan oil cooperative"
    ]
  }
};
var MONTHS={
  oct:{label:'October',dates:['oct1','oct2']},
  nov:{label:'November',dates:['nov1','nov2','nov3']},
  dec:{label:'December',dates:['dec1','dec2','dec3']},
  jan:{label:'January',dates:['jan1','jan2','jan3']},
  fev:{label:'February',dates:['fev1','fev2','fev3','fev4']},
  mar:{label:'March',dates:['mar1','mar2','mar3','mar4']},
  avr:{label:'April',dates:['avr1','avr2','avr3','avr4']}
};
var DATES={
  oct1:{label:'Oct 5 → 12'},
  oct2:{label:'Oct 10 → 17',complet:true},
  nov1:{label:'Nov 7 → 14'},
  nov2:{label:'Nov 14 → 21'},
  nov3:{label:'Nov 21 → 28'},
  dec1:{label:'Dec 5 → 12'},
  dec2:{label:'Dec 12 → 19'},
  dec3:{label:'Dec 19 → 26'},
  jan1:{label:'Jan 9 → 16'},
  jan2:{label:'Jan 16 → 23'},
  jan3:{label:'Jan 23 → 30'},
  fev1:{label:'Jan 30 → Feb 06'},
  fev2:{label:'Feb 6 → 13'},
  fev3:{label:'Feb 13 → 20'},
  fev4:{label:'Feb 20 → 27'},
  mar1:{label:'Feb 27 → Mar 06'},
  mar2:{label:'Mar 6 → 13'},
  mar3:{label:'Mar 13 → 20'},
  mar4:{label:'Mar 20 → 27'},
  avr1:{label:'Mar 27 → Apr 03'},
  avr2:{label:'Apr 03 → 10'},
  avr3:{label:'Apr 10 → 17'},
  avr4:{label:'Apr 17 → 24'}
};
var PRICE={surf:690,kite:820};
var PROMO={};
var s={act:null,month:null,date:null,n:1};
function g(id){return document.getElementById(id)}
function updateActCard(){
  if(!s.act){
    g('bk-act-badge').textContent="🏄 INCLUDED ACTIVITIES";
    g('bk-act-list').innerHTML='<li>Choose an activity to see the full details</li>';
    return;
  }
  var c=ACT_CONTENT[s.act];
  g('bk-act-badge').textContent=c.badge;
  g('bk-act-list').innerHTML=c.items.map(function(t){return '<li>'+t+'</li>';}).join('');
}
function renderMonths(){
  var wrap=g('bk-months');
  wrap.innerHTML='';
  g('bk-dates-sub').innerHTML='';
  g('bk-custom-block').classList.remove('show');
  if(!s.act){
    wrap.innerHTML='<span class="bk-dates-placeholder">Choose an activity first</span>';
    return;
  }
  Object.keys(MONTHS).forEach(function(mk){
    var m=MONTHS[mk];
    var b=document.createElement('button');
    b.className='bk-date';
    b.textContent=m.label;
    b.onclick=function(){bkMonth(mk,b)};
    wrap.appendChild(b);
  });
  var custom=document.createElement('button');
  custom.className='bk-date bk-date-custom';
  custom.textContent='✏️ Choose your dates';
  custom.onclick=function(){bkCustomToggle(custom)};
  wrap.appendChild(custom);
}
window.bkAct=function(a,btn){
  s.act=a;s.month=null;s.date=null;
  ['surf','kite'].forEach(function(k){g('bk-act-'+k).classList.toggle('on',k===a)});
  g('bk-urgency').textContent='';
  updateActCard();
  renderMonths();
  upd();
};
window.bkMonth=function(mk,btn){
  s.month=mk;s.date=null;
  document.querySelectorAll('#bk-months .bk-date').forEach(function(b){b.classList.remove('on')});
  btn.classList.add('on');
  g('bk-custom-block').classList.remove('show');
  var sub=g('bk-dates-sub');
  sub.innerHTML='';
  MONTHS[mk].dates.forEach(function(dk){
    var d=DATES[dk];
    var b=document.createElement('button');
    b.className='bk-date'+(PROMO[dk]&&PROMO[dk][s.act]?' promo':'');
    b.textContent=d.label+(d.complet?' · Full':'');
    if(d.complet){
      b.disabled=true;
    }else{
      b.onclick=function(){bkDate(dk,b)};
      if(PROMO[dk]&&PROMO[dk][s.act]){
        var badge=document.createElement('span');
        badge.className='bk-promo-badge';
        badge.textContent='🔥 Promo';
        b.appendChild(badge);
      }
    }
    sub.appendChild(b);
  });
  g('bk-urgency').textContent='';
  upd();
};
window.bkDate=function(dk,btn){
  s.date=dk;
  document.querySelectorAll('#bk-dates-sub .bk-date').forEach(function(b){b.classList.remove('on')});
  btn.classList.add('on');
  if(PROMO[dk]&&PROMO[dk][s.act]){
    g('bk-urgency').textContent='🔥 Special offer on this date';
    g('bk-urgency').style.color='#e4a0af';
  }else{
    g('bk-urgency').textContent='';
  }
  upd();
};
window.bkCustomToggle=function(btn){
  s.month='custom';s.date='custom';
  document.querySelectorAll('#bk-months .bk-date').forEach(function(b){b.classList.remove('on')});
  btn.classList.add('on');
  g('bk-dates-sub').innerHTML='';
  g('bk-custom-block').classList.add('show');
  g('bk-urgency').textContent='';
  upd();
};
window.bkCnt=function(d){
  s.n=Math.max(1,Math.min(12,s.n+d));
  g('bk-cnt').textContent=s.n;upd();
};
function getPrice(){
  if(PROMO[s.date]&&PROMO[s.date][s.act])return PROMO[s.date][s.act].price;
  return PRICE[s.act];
}
function upd(){
  if(!s.act||!s.date){g('bk-price').classList.add('hidden');return;}
  var p=getPrice();
  var t=p*s.n;
  g('bk-price').classList.remove('hidden');
  g('bk-pamt').textContent=t.toLocaleString('en-GB')+'€';
  g('bk-psub').textContent=p+'€ × '+s.n+' people';
  var promo=PROMO[s.date]&&PROMO[s.date][s.act];
  if(promo){
    var oldT=PRICE[s.act]*s.n;
    g('bk-pold').textContent=oldT.toLocaleString('en-GB')+'€';
    g('bk-pold').style.display='inline';
    g('bk-psave').textContent='You save '+(oldT-t).toLocaleString('en-GB')+'€ on this date';
    g('bk-psave').style.display='block';
  }else{
    g('bk-pold').style.display='none';
    g('bk-psave').style.display='none';
  }
}
window.bkNext=function(){
  if(!s.act){g('bk-urgency').textContent='⚠️ Please choose an activity first';g('bk-urgency').style.color='#c0392b';return;}
  if(!s.date){g('bk-urgency').textContent='⚠️ Please choose a date';g('bk-urgency').style.color='#c0392b';return;}
  if(s.date==='custom'&&(!g('bk-date-from').value||!g('bk-date-to').value)){
    g('bk-urgency').textContent='⚠️ Please enter your dates';g('bk-urgency').style.color='#c0392b';return;
  }
  var p=getPrice();
  var t=p*s.n;
  var ps=t.toLocaleString('en-GB')+'€';
  var actLabel=s.act==='surf'?'🏄 Surf':'🪁 Kitesurf';
  var dateLabel=s.date==='custom'?('From '+g('bk-date-from').value+' to '+g('bk-date-to').value):DATES[s.date].label;
  g('bk-sum').innerHTML='<strong>'+actLabel+'</strong><br>'+dateLabel+' · '+s.n+' people · '+ps;
  g('bk-s1').classList.remove('on');g('bk-s2').classList.add('on');
};
window.bkBack=function(){g('bk-s2').classList.remove('on');g('bk-s1').classList.add('on');};
window.bkSubmit=function(){
  var ok=true;
  ['bk-fn','bk-ln','bk-email'].forEach(function(id){var e=g(id);if(!e.value.trim()){e.classList.add('err');ok=false;}else{e.classList.remove('err');}});
  if(!ok)return;
  var btn=g('bk-btn2');btn.disabled=true;btn.textContent='Sending...';
  var p=getPrice();
  var t=p*s.n;
  var actLabel=s.act==='surf'?'Surf':'Kitesurf';
  var dateLabel=s.date==='custom'?('From '+g('bk-date-from').value+' to '+g('bk-date-to').value):DATES[s.date].label;
  var fd=new FormData();
  fd.append('access_key','REDACTED');
  fd.append('subject','🏕️ Mogasurf Stay Booking · '+actLabel);
  fd.append('from_name','Mogasurf Website');
  fd.append('cc','info@mogasurf.com,redacted@example.com,redacted@example.com');
  fd.append('botcheck','');
  fd.append('Activity',actLabel);
  fd.append('Stay dates',dateLabel);
  fd.append('People',s.n);
  fd.append('Estimated total',t+'€');
  fd.append('First name',g('bk-fn').value.trim());
  fd.append('Last name',g('bk-ln').value.trim());
  fd.append('Email',g('bk-email').value.trim());
  fd.append('Phone',g('bk-cc').value+' '+g('bk-phone').value.trim());
  if(g('bk-msg').value.trim())fd.append('Message',g('bk-msg').value.trim());
  fetch('https://api.web3forms.com/submit',{method:'POST',body:fd})
  .then(function(r){return r.json()})
  .then(function(d){
    if(d.success){
      g('bk-fields').style.display='none';
      g('bk-ok').classList.add('show');
      if(typeof fbq==='function')fbq('track','Lead');
      window.dataLayer=window.dataLayer||[];
      window.dataLayer.push({'event':'camp_booking_success'});
    }else{alert('Error. Please contact us on WhatsApp.');}
    btn.disabled=false;btn.textContent='Confirm my booking →';
  })
  .catch(function(){alert('Network error. WhatsApp: +212 618 910 431');btn.disabled=false;btn.textContent='Confirm my booking →';});
};
renderMonths();
})();
</script>				</div>
					</div>
				</div>
				</div>
			</div>
</main>
